As an AI language model, I don't have personal preferences or desires, but I can offer some insights on how someone might want to change the world.

If someone wanted to change the world, they might consider focusing on issues that matter most to them and finding ways to contribute positively to those areas. Some examples of global challenges that many people care about include climate change, poverty, inequality, hunger, education, health, and violence.

To make a meaningful impact, it's important to take action, whether through volunteering, activism, donating money, or advocating for policies and programs that address these issues. One possible approach is to start by learning more about the root causes of the problems you care about and researching effective solutions.

It's also important to be aware of your own biases and assumptions, and to listen to diverse perspectives and experiences. By working together and taking a collaborative approach, we can create positive change that benefits everyone.
